card.name: Punctuation before 'no adjustment needed'
card.fires_on: Closing parentheses and commas ending a patient-group or condition clause in dosing text, where a statement like 'no dose adjustment is needed' could come next. Also some words like 'patients' or 'others' after 'In some'.

modes.label: Closing bracket after a condition
modes.description: A closing parenthesis or comma that ends a description of a patient group, severity grade or measurement.
modes.example: If ertapenem for injection is given at least 6 hours prior to hemodialysis<<,>> no supplementary dose is needed.

modes.label: Word ending 'in some' clause
modes.description: A word closing an 'in some patients' or 'in others' phrase, or a time phrase before a following clause.
modes.example: In some<< patients>> it may be necessary to administer ranit

card.writes: It pushes the model toward starting the next clause with 'no' and away from 'there'.
card.plain: It fires where a patient-group clause ends and a phrase like 'no adjustment needed' is likely to follow.
